label: reject
reason: The evidence quote presents "Pancoast tumor" as a possible cause (etiology) of the lower brachial plexus deficit, not as a member of the deficit. The relation "member_of" is misapplied; the claim conflates causal association with taxonomic membership. The source does not state that Pancoast tumor is a type of brachial plexus deficit, nor does it categorically classify the tumor within the deficit class.
